'''Mac''' was a [[Technician/Legends|technician]] and member of the [[Happy Blasters]]. He did not reveal where he was from, only stating it was about three [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] from [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Mac joined the Happy Blasters out of a sense of curiosity, signing on because he was offered the chance to use his skills to enhance the interior of the ''[[Starcat (light freighter)|Starcat]]'', essentially making it a fortress.<ref name="Scout" />
